cases.title: "Show me" demonstrates on the target pair only

checks.detail: claude failed to run: spawnSync claude ETIMEDOUT

rubric.reason: judge failed to run: claude failed to run: spawnSync claude ETIMEDOUT

Turn 2 calls preview_frame at time 1, which is inside the focus pair Title › Position 0.5–1.5 s. The reply refers to it in one clause: "That was the frame at 1 s, where Title is partway through that move."

The only edit is one set_ease on demo_target (1/ADBE Transform Group/ADBE Position/1), and the turn ends by naming the three remaining pairs: "Title's second Position move (1.5 s to 3 s), its Scale and its Opacity (both 0.5 s to 1.5 s). Ease those and say done."

All layers, properties and times (Title Position 0.5–1.5 and 1.5–3, Scale and Opacity 0.5–1.5, Subtitle Opacity, Old Take, Icon) match snapshot_project, and "10 pairs on five visible layers" adds up: 9 visible linear plus Subtitle's partly_eased pair, with hidden Old Take excluded, across Title, Subtitle, CTRL, Bar and Glow.

The Turn 2 'show me' demo turn gives three sentences of explanation ("Before the ease… That's what we call linear motion… Easing makes it slow down…") where one is allowed, then adds a bulleted "To check it in the timeline" what-to-look-at list, which § 6 names as a fail.
